tests.name: a missing existing project fails the run with errorKind project_missing
tests.reason: Deleted project failure loses its machine-readable error kind in history.

tests.name: a restart during the creation: the pending path is on disk, removed, and made again
tests.reason: Restart leaks or reuses an incompletely created temp project.

tests.name: a failed creation removes what it left and records nothing pending
tests.reason: Failed clone leaves an orphan temp directory or pending marker.

tests.name: a run whose saved state cannot be read is due for the sweeper
tests.reason: Unreadable run state leaks its retained temp directory forever.

tests.name: stopping during the finalize's delete leaves the project due for the sweeper
tests.reason: Shutdown during cleanup loses the only scheduled deletion record.

tests.name: a release event clones at its tag; a PR head the clone cannot resolve is retried at the PR branch
tests.reason: Release clone uses the wrong commit/tag or abbreviated PR failure never falls back to its branch.

tests.name: a run is not active until its record exists; a failed create leaves nothing active
tests.reason: Disk failure leaves a phantom active run blocking later work.

tests.name: a stored run naming a block `__proto__` is interrupted, never walked
tests.reason: Persisted prototype block identifiers execute or pollute ordinary objects.

tests.name: an invalid URL quoting a long secret is redacted before it is cut
tests.reason: Invalid URL truncation leaks a prefix of a long credential.

tests.name: a Wait block's timer resumes at the same wall-clock instant
tests.reason: Restart resets a persisted wait duration.

tests.name: a retry delay resumes, then the next attempt runs
tests.reason: Retry delay is lost or the attempt counter starts again.

tests.name: a code process that ended while the daemon was down: its exit.json is read
tests.reason: An offline process failure is reported as successful or loses its recorded exception.

tests.name: a process gone without a record is interrupted — retried when the policy allows
tests.reason: Missing exit record is trusted as success or bypasses retry policy.

tests.name: a child run is re-subscribed by its parent
tests.reason: Parent never resumes when its already-running child finishes.

tests.name: an HTTP GET is re-issued; a POST fails interrupted
tests.reason: Restart repeats a potentially side-effecting POST or fails to reissue a safe GET.

tests.name: a block running without a WaitingOn: a pure block re-runs as the same attempt
tests.reason: Pure block crash causes interruption or reruns succeeded upstream work.

tests.name: the engine stopping while a block persists its wait state: the run is not failed, and resumes after the restart
tests.reason: Shutdown while persisting a wait records a spurious block failure.

tests.name: a block reached while the engine stops never starts: it stays pending and runs after the restart (not interrupted)
tests.reason: Stop during graph advancement marks an unstarted block interrupted.

tests.name: a Run workflow block whose child the stopping engine refused (ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE) is no validation failure: it runs again after the restart
tests.reason: Stopping engine's refused child launch becomes permanent validation failure.

tests.name: a Run workflow block found running without its WaitingOn adopts the child it did start (never a second one)
tests.reason: Lost child acknowledgement executes a second child.

tests.name: a Run workflow block's child is bound to its attempt: attempt 2, cut off before its launch, runs its own child — never adopts attempt 1's
tests.reason: Retry adopts the preceding attempt's child; persisted parentAttempt provides an independent oracle.

tests.name: a child recorded by an older build (no binding) is still adopted when it was queued since the attempt started
tests.reason: Legacy unbound child is replayed instead of adopted; fixture selects recorded metadata rather than generated IDs.

tests.name: whether the attempt started a child cannot be read: the block is interrupted, never re-run — even with retries left
tests.reason: Uncertain child existence is treated as definite absence and duplicated.

tests.name: a failed child lookup fails the run only after its children are linked: a sibling block's live child is cancelled with it
tests.reason: Lookup failure leaves sibling child work running; fixture selects actual persisted child identities.

tests.name: runChild cannot tell whether the attempt's child exists: the block fails interrupted, never retried, no child started
tests.reason: Fresh child lookup I/O error is retried as an ordinary validation failure.

tests.name: an older build's child listed but unreadable is no definite absence: the block is interrupted, not re-run
tests.reason: Unreadable legacy child is duplicated instead of failing closed; fixture locates the recorded child independently.

tests.name: a side-effecting block running without a WaitingOn is interrupted (no retry)
tests.reason: Unrecorded side-effecting block is replayed automatically.

tests.name: queued runs start after a restart; a run whose definition cannot be read is marked interrupted
tests.reason: Queued work vanishes on restart or malformed definition blocks recovery of other runs.

tests.name: stop() persists the last state and writes nothing after
tests.reason: Old engine writes over successor state after handover.

tests.name: IF takes one branch; the other is skipped with its edges dead
tests.reason: Unchosen IF branch executes or fails to propagate dead paths.

tests.name: Switch: the first matching case wins, the fallback takes the rest, no fallback kills every edge
tests.reason: Switch selects the wrong output or executes an unmatched branch.

tests.name: independent branches run concurrently; Merge (all) waits for every live input
tests.reason: Concurrent inputs serialize or all-mode merge fires before all live inputs.

tests.name: Merge (first) runs on the first arrival and ignores the later one
tests.reason: First-mode merge runs again on a late arrival.

tests.name: a block with several live inputs and no Merge reads the merge object
tests.reason: A multi-input block loses one upstream branch.

tests.name: a failure with an error edge routes down it and the run succeeds
tests.reason: Error edges lose partial output/diagnostic or route as ordinary success.

tests.name: a failure without an error edge fails the run and cancels the running siblings
tests.reason: Unhandled failure leaves sibling work running.

tests.name: retries wait their delay on a persisted timer, then succeed
tests.reason: Retry executes before its durable delay or retains stale error after success.

tests.name: all_burnt and limit_exceeded failures are never retried
tests.reason: Known unrecoverable cap/account exhaustion is retried.

tests.name: an agent waiting for a usage reset (kind agent, phase waiting-reset) reads waiting and resumes as such
tests.reason: Usage-reset waiting appears active instead of waiting in run state.

tests.name: retries exhausted: the last failure stands
tests.reason: Final retry failure vanishes or retry count is ignored.

tests.name: a disabled block passes its input through as success without running
tests.reason: Disabled block executes or drops upstream data.

tests.name: Stop as failure fails the run with its message and value
tests.reason: Failure Stop drops configured output/message or leaves siblings running.

tests.name: code's stop() ends the run as stopped
tests.reason: Code Stop walks downstream or emits wrong final status.

tests.name: a trigger-less workflow starts at its roots with the manual input
tests.reason: Manual roots receive no input when workflow has no explicit trigger.

tests.name: a fired trigger runs; the others are skipped
tests.reason: Firing one trigger executes unrelated trigger branches.

tests.name: a run with validation errors is refused (manual) or recorded as failed (trigger)
tests.reason: Invalid manual run executes work or scheduled invalid fire vanishes from history.

tests.name: expectedRevision: a manual run starts only on that revision, refused before any block otherwise
tests.reason: Revision-pinned caller runs a newer workflow than it approved.

tests.name: a projectOverride block runs in that project; a missing one fails the block
tests.reason: Per-block project override is ignored or a deleted override runs elsewhere.

tests.name: an executor that throws or answers nonsense fails its block as internal
tests.reason: Unexpected executor failure escapes the run instead of becoming a block error.

tests.name: a big output goes to a file with an inline preview; downstream and nodeOutput read it whole
tests.reason: Spilled output leaks its host path or downstream receives only the preview.

tests.name: an output over the hard cap fails the block with limit_exceeded
tests.reason: Oversized executor output is accepted and stored.

tests.name: a secret appearing in an output, an error or a warning is redacted everywhere
tests.reason: Persisted/published output/error/warning exposes a secret.

tests.name: the per-run update events are throttled; the final state is always published
tests.reason: Burst updates lose latest activity/final state or publish finished before final update.

tests.name: cancel mid-block aborts it and ends the run cancelled
tests.reason: Cancellation remains active, repeats notification, or executes downstream.

tests.name: a block that ignores its abort cannot hold a cancelled run forever
tests.reason: Uncooperative block holds a cancelled run indefinitely.

tests.name: the run timeout fails the run and cancels what runs
tests.reason: Run deadline leaves its blocks active.

tests.name: skip: a second fire records a skipped stub; force runs anyway
tests.reason: Skip overlap omits visible skipped history or force cannot proceed.

tests.name: queue: one pending fire waits for the active run; a further fire is skipped
tests.reason: Queue policy starts too many pending runs or fails to release its one queued run.

tests.name: parallel: up to maxConcurrent, then skipped
tests.reason: Parallel overlap exceeds configured maxConcurrent.

tests.name: the global run cap queues runs beyond it, FIFO
tests.reason: Global run cap loses FIFO queued work.

tests.name: a queued run can be cancelled before it starts
tests.reason: Queued cancellation starts work or invents startedAt.

tests.name: agent blocks and sandbox processes wait behind their global caps
tests.reason: Agent/process resource limits fail to queue/release pending blocks.

tests.name: an agent block's timer wait releases its slot; waking takes it back
tests.reason: Reset wait holds an agent slot and starves later blocks.

tests.name: usePinned: a pinned block is not executed and downstream reads its pin
tests.reason: Pinned output executes the block or fails to feed downstream.

tests.name: without usePinned, pins are ignored
tests.reason: Ordinary runs silently execute stale pinned test data.

tests.name: fromNodeId runs that block and its downstream; upstream from pins, else the latest run
tests.reason: Run-from-block uses wrong upstream data or executes upstream blocks.

tests.name: testNode executes only that block, even with no upstream data
tests.reason: Single-block test executes downstream or invents input without upstream data.

tests.name: testNode seeds only the tested block's upstream: downstream and side branches stay skipped
tests.reason: Single-block test seeds unrelated/downstream outputs from a previous run.

tests.name: retryOf reuses the succeeded blocks and re-runs the failed ones
tests.reason: Retry reruns successful upstream work or loses trigger input.

tests.name: retryOf + fromNodeId on the fired trigger re-runs everything with the same event
tests.reason: Retry-from-trigger reuses stale blocks or triggers unrelated branch.

tests.name: retryOf + a non-trigger fromNodeId runs from there on that run's upstream outputs
tests.reason: Retry-from-block reads a later run's outputs.

tests.name: retryOf does not reuse a success that sits below a block being re-run
tests.reason: Retried branch incorrectly retains a formerly successful error handler.

tests.name: created per run, deleted when the run succeeds
tests.reason: Successful temporary workflow leaks its per-run checkout.

tests.name: kept keepFailedTempDays when the run fails; Delete now removes it
tests.reason: Failure retention deletes project too early or Delete now leaves it.

tests.name: a git trigger on the project repo clones at the event's sha
tests.reason: Git-triggered temp run clones a moving branch instead of event commit.

tests.name: the child's final output is the block's output; runs are linked both ways
tests.reason: Parent loses child output or persisted run linkage.

tests.name: a child given text someone else wrote is marked untrusted, so its prompts frame it
tests.reason: Untrusted child input bypasses prompt framing.

tests.name: a failing child fails the block with child_run_failed
tests.reason: Failed child is reported as successful parent block.

tests.name: the depth limit and cycles are refused at run time
tests.reason: Runtime recursion creates unbounded cycles/depth.

tests.name: cancelling the parent cancels the child
tests.reason: Parent cancel leaves its child active.

tests.name: sub-workflow definitions are frozen when the top-level run starts: a child (and a grandchild) edited mid-run runs as it was
tests.reason: Mid-run edits change the child/grandchild code being executed.

tests.name: a sub-workflow deleted after the run started fails its block; none frozen when there are no sub-workflows
tests.reason: Deleted frozen child executes silently or plain workflow stores unrelated snapshots.

tests.name: child runs bypass the global run cap (no deadlock)
tests.reason: Sub-workflow chain deadlocks at the top-level run cap.

tests.name: deleting a workflow cancels its runs and stops writing them
tests.reason: Late block result recreates data after workflow deletion.

tests.name: enabledTriggers lists enabled workflows' live trigger nodes; definition changes are forwarded
tests.reason: Disabled triggers are returned to schedulers or definition changes do not propagate.

tests.name: recordSkipped writes a visible stub
tests.reason: Missed trigger disappears instead of producing inspectable skipped history.

tests.name: cloneRefProblem accepts branches, tags and shas
tests.reason: Legitimate branch/tag/full commit ref is refused before git.

tests.name: cloneRefProblem refuses empty, long, option-like, whitespace and control characters
tests.reason: Ref becomes a git option or contains process-argument control/whitespace.

tests.name: sha detection: only full ids skip --branch; short hex may be either
tests.reason: Short hex branch is mistaken for a detached commit or SHA-256 commit treated as branch.

tests.name: cloneArgs: a name rides --branch, a sha and no ref clone plainly, the URL follows --
tests.reason: Clone loses -- separator or applies --branch to a full commit.

tests.name: isMissingRemoteRef recognises git's messages
tests.reason: Missing-ref fallback runs on an authentication failure.

tests.name: resolveAbbreviatedSha: one commit by prefix, null when none or ambiguous
tests.reason: Ambiguous abbreviated commit resolves to arbitrary advertised object.

tests.name: parseLsRemote reads heads, lightweight and annotated tags, and the HEAD symref
tests.reason: Git heads, HEAD symref or annotated-tag commit is parsed incorrectly.

tests.name: parseLsRemote: a peeled line before its tag, CRLF, junk and uppercase shas
tests.reason: CRLF/uppercase/junk or peeled-before-tag listing yields wrong refs.

tests.name: parseLsRemote: no HEAD line → no defaultBranch; a __proto__ branch stays an own key
tests.reason: Hostile branch name mutates object prototype or absent HEAD invents default.

tests.name: parseLsRemote: SHA-256 object ids
tests.reason: SHA-256 repository heads disappear from polling.

tests.name: repoKeyOf: every GitHub form of one repo has one key
tests.reason: Equivalent GitHub transport/browse forms create separate repository identities.

tests.name: repoKeyOf: Bitbucket Cloud's old and new SSH hosts are one host
tests.reason: Old/new Bitbucket SSH hosts get separate cursors.

tests.name: repoKeyOf: Bitbucket Server/DC forms reduce to host/project/repo
tests.reason: DC context/browse/SSH forms identify different repositories.

tests.name: repoKeyOf: other hosts keep their whole path (GitLab subgroups)
tests.reason: GitLab subgroup information is discarded.

tests.name: repoKeyOf: refuses what git would not be handed
tests.reason: Unsafe/local/option URL is handed to git by key derivation.

tests.name: repoDisplayName keeps the original case
tests.reason: Trigger repository display loses user-visible case/path.

tests.name: remoteUrlProblem accepts the four transports and refuses the rest
tests.reason: Unsafe git transport reaches remote process invocation.

tests.name: stripUrlCredentials drops the whole http(s) userinfo (a token may be the user) and an ssh password
tests.reason: Credential userinfo persists in stored remote URL.

tests.name: redactUrlUserinfo hides a token user in http(s) text and a password anywhere, keeps ssh logins
tests.reason: Provider stderr exposes token-as-user/password but drops necessary SSH login.

tests.name: a shell block gets its env (secrets included), never a rendered script; exit codes map
tests.reason: Real shell receives interpolated executable data, drops env/streams, or loses nonzero exit output.

tests.name: cancelling a run kills its shell promptly
tests.reason: Cancelling engine reports completion while its real process remains alive.

tests.name: JSON responses are parsed; query and headers are rendered (secrets allowed, redacted after)
tests.reason: Real HTTP request misencodes query/headers or fails to parse JSON.

tests.name: text stays text; redirects are followed or not; statuses map
tests.reason: Redirect/status configuration is ignored or failed response body is lost.

tests.name: bodies: JSON rendered from a value, form fields, text
tests.reason: JSON/form/text request bodies reach the server incorrectly or invalid JSON is sent.

tests.name: the body cap, the timeout and a network error each fail the block with their kind
tests.reason: Oversized/hung/disconnected/unsupported HTTP requests lose distinct failure kinds.

tests.name: until HH:MM waits for the next such time in the block's time zone
tests.reason: Wait-until ignores block timezone or resumes at wrong date.

tests.name: the workflow's own time zone applies when the block names none
tests.reason: Missing block timezone ignores workflow timezone.

tests.name: stdout and stderr are the tails within the cap, with a warning; the whole log stays on disk
tests.reason: Shell output keeps head instead of tail, silently truncates, or discards durable full log.

tests.name: an ordinary pattern answers
tests.reason: Worker cannot return both matching and nonmatching results with flags.

tests.name: a catastrophic pattern is stopped at the deadline, the loop stays free, and the next search works
tests.reason: Catastrophic user regex blocks daemon, survives its timeout, or poisons next request.

tests.name: a clipped value is redacted before the clip
tests.reason: This case invokes only the shared API and never the daemon regex worker. Its unique privacy assertions (false result, no long-secret prefix, placeholder present) are folded into the existing API numeric-comparison case at the lowest owner. The two real regex worker timeout/recovery tests remain.
tests.survivingOwner: packages/api/src/workflows/rules.test.ts — numeric comparisons parse numbers and warn on non-numbers

tests.name: index: direct and transitive callers, cycles, calls each once; prompt uses with their blocks, a disabled block too
tests.reason: Transitive/cyclic callers, disabled saved-prompt uses, or non-agent false positives are misreported.

tests.name: index fails closed: before a rebuild, while the file is unreadable, and for any id an unreadable record mentions
tests.reason: Unknown startup/corrupt definition is reported as safe to edit with no callers.

tests.name: index: Agent Profile uses — agent blocks with a profileId, a disabled one too; re-targeted, deleted, and unknown when an unreadable record names it
tests.reason: Profile edit/delete safety misses disabled launches, stale retargets, or unknown future references.

tests.name: the store keeps the index through create, patch, replace, duplicate and delete; a reload rebuilds the same answers from disk
tests.reason: Definition write and reference map diverge across real persistence/reload; surviving owner the real store/reload reference case also asserts this contract without repeating a separate fixture.

tests.name: startup tolerates other builds' records: an unreadable one that names a workflow makes its callers unknown; an unreadable file makes every answer unknown
tests.reason: Unreadable newer definitions permit edits/deletes on guessed caller absence.

tests.name: race: an answer never lags a save that landed, and a write whose callers changed since the card is refused (CALLERS_CHANGED), nothing saved
tests.reason: Approval based on older callers mutates workflow despite newly landed usage.

tests.name: routes: GET the references of a workflow, a saved prompt and an Agent Profile; DELETE ?expectCallers= is the same precondition
tests.reason: Wire reference metadata/precondition parsing differs from service rules.

tests.name: a load that fails part-way never leaves a known index: every answer is unknown, and the error is rethrown
tests.reason: Partial load leaves trusted reference answers despite failing startup.

tests.name: routes without a wired projectPathFilter name no guessed workspace for an existing project (a temp project's stays)
tests.reason: Unwired resolver invents a workspace from an untrusted path layout.

tests.name: without the engine: acting routes answer 503 ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE
tests.reason: Acting endpoint runs without an available engine instead of stable 503.

tests.name: without the engine: history, run detail and outputs are read from the run store
tests.reason: Engine outage hides persisted history/full output or exposes host bookkeeping.

tests.name: validate uses the daemon's saved-prompt catalog and reports malformed or missing resources
tests.reason: Saved-prompt catalog is omitted from route validation.

tests.name: the list filters by project: the existing project, plus temp workflows of its workspace
tests.reason: Surviving public owner preserves exact project filtering and default/custom notification flags on actual HTTP rows. Independent source is workflow design §5.11/§7.1; a dropped notify projection changes client notifications. Literal flags disagree with a broken summary, and the route survives helper refactors. No other retained route observes both flags.

tests.name: block types and the schedule preview
tests.reason: Schedule preview accepts invalid cron or ignores result cap.

tests.name: secrets: names only, write-only values, scoped to an existing workflow
tests.reason: Secrets endpoint leaks values or permits unknown workflow scope.

tests.name: delete cascades: active runs cancelled through the engine, runs and secrets removed
tests.reason: Delete fails to cancel/cascade only target runs/secrets or leaks global secret list for missing scope.

tests.name: with the engine: runs, tests, cancels and summaries go through it
tests.reason: Transport loses missing-workflow/node/inactive-run refusal codes.

tests.name: log windows are redacted and report their position
tests.reason: Log route leaks raw secret or reports wrong resumable byte cursor.

tests.name: log follow streams as the file grows and redacts a secret split across writes
tests.reason: Real chunked HTTP follow leaks credential fragments across writes.

tests.name: an engine refusal keeps its status, code and problems (never a generic 500)
tests.reason: Engine errors become generic 500 and lose actionable problems.

tests.name: DELETE of a secret refuses prototype names and unknown workflows
tests.reason: Secret DELETE accepts prototype-name operations or invalid scope.

tests.name: write routes take a body past 1 MiB, and one past their limit answers LIMIT_EXCEEDED
tests.reason: Default server body limit rejects supported definitions, or oversized writes lose LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

tests.name: account-preview refuses a chain entry it cannot read (400, never 500)
tests.reason: Malformed account preview raises 500.

tests.name: the delete cascade keeps a run record whose temp project it could not delete; deletes it directly when it can
tests.reason: Workflow deletion loses last cleanup record when project delete unavailable.

tests.name: expression preview: returns node-relative data, missing/error state and source metadata
tests.reason: Expression route drops render/missing/parse metadata or exposes non-upstream node.

tests.name: expression preview: secrets render as placeholders and a secret inside an output is redacted
tests.reason: Secret references and transformed/nested outputs leak through expression preview.

tests.name: expression preview: the block's point of view decides input; several inputs are keyed by name
tests.reason: Preview computes input from wrong block's viewpoint.

tests.name: expression preview: value mode keeps a number a number and says when nothing was read
tests.reason: Typed value preview coerces JSON number to text or hides missing state.

tests.name: expression preview: pinned outputs replace recorded ones; with no run they are the only data
tests.reason: Pins override when disabled or upstream-only pin filtering is lost.

tests.name: expression preview: the default run is the latest that reached the block; big outputs are read whole
tests.reason: Preview chooses wrong reached run, loads a preview as full output, or fails to cap expansion.

tests.name: expression preview: refusals use the workflow error codes
tests.reason: Preview failures use wrong workflow/node/run/request code.

tests.name: expression preview: a block name containing a secret value stays readable (only values are redacted)
tests.reason: Secret redaction mutates block/project field names instead of values.

tests.name: expression preview: a starting block of a workflow with no trigger reads the run's input (engine computeForced)
tests.reason: Triggerless roots lose input or disconnected triggered nodes receive data.

tests.name: expression preview: rendering stops at the byte cap and parse errors are deduplicated and capped
tests.reason: Expression cap fails to bound expansion/diagnostics or double-counts repeated parse errors.

tests.name: expression preview: without a block, a queued newest run gives way to the newest with finished blocks
tests.reason: Newest queued run masks usable data from a prior finished run.

tests.name: create/save: run.json is atomic and 0600, the last save wins, the index follows
tests.reason: Concurrent saves land out of order, permit loose file mode, or leave active index stale.

tests.name: init rebuilds the index from the run directories; an unreadable run.json is skipped
tests.reason: Stale index cache overrides directory authority or unreadable record breaks history.

tests.name: paging: `before` is a run id cursor, newest first; an unknown cursor is a first page
tests.reason: History cursor duplicates/skips rows or fails unknown-cursor fallback.

tests.name: sweep keeps the newest 100 and nothing older than 30 days, preserving active runs
tests.reason: Retention deletes active work, retains excess/ancient runs, or late writes recreate removed data.

tests.name: sweep keeps a run whose temporary project is still there, until the project is deleted
tests.reason: Retention removes the only record of an undeleted temp project.

tests.name: events append as NDJSON; attempt dirs and output files live under the run
tests.reason: Event order changes, path escapes run containment, or whole output loses private mode.

tests.name: deleteForWorkflow removes every run of that workflow only
tests.reason: Deleting one workflow removes another's runs.

tests.name: persistedRunToWire: frozen sub-workflow definitions cross the wire as their revisions only; a run without them has none
tests.reason: Frozen child code leaks over wire instead of only its approved revision.

tests.name: toRunSummary / persistedRunToWire: bookkeeping stripped, outputs cut to the preview
tests.reason: Public run/summary leaks pending state/host path or breaks UTF-8 preview.

tests.name: exists: a recorded run (readable or not) is true; a missing one false; another I/O error throws; deleted and invalid ids are false
tests.reason: Unreadable exists is confused with absence and can duplicate side effects.

tests.name: no preload active: NODE_OPTIONS is the block's own, or absent
tests.reason: Daemon NODE_OPTIONS leaks into a workflow or explicit block options are dropped.

tests.name: a preload active: required alone, or appended after the block's NODE_OPTIONS
tests.reason: Plugin preload is lost or overwrites block NODE_OPTIONS; literal expected --require bytes replace production-derived oracle.

tests.name: windows of any size cut at character boundaries and join to the whole text
tests.reason: Byte cursor splits UTF-8 or drops/duplicates log text.

tests.name: a secret is never split across windows
tests.reason: Log windows expose a whole credential or pieces across boundaries.

tests.name: an offset inside a secret serves its placeholder, never its tail
tests.reason: Caller-chosen offset exposes credential tail.

tests.name: holdTail keeps back a partial character and a possible secret prefix
tests.reason: Live append serves an incomplete character/credential before it can be safely redacted.

tests.name: a missing file reads as empty
tests.reason: Missing attempt log raises instead of serving empty window.

tests.name: yields as the file grows and ends once it is not live and fully read
tests.reason: Streaming loses append data/redaction or never ends after writer exit.

tests.name: an abort ends a live follow
tests.reason: Aborted client remains attached to live log.

tests.name: text: every value ≥ 4 chars, longest first
tests.reason: Short-token policy or overlapping longest-match protection corrupts redaction.

tests.name: value: deep through arrays and objects, values only
tests.reason: Nested output redaction leaks values, mutates keys, or changes caller input.

tests.name: special regex characters in a value are literal
tests.reason: Regex-like credential is interpreted as a pattern.

tests.name: an async module returns its result and logs, then exits despite an open handle
tests.reason: Real code-host import, top-level await, context arguments, return/log bytes and open-handle exit fail together; no fake engine case proves actual JavaScript child execution or teardown.

tests.name: undefined returns as null
tests.reason: Undefined JS result is lost instead of valid JSON null.

tests.name: a throw is a failure with message and stack
tests.reason: Code exception loses its failure/stack.

tests.name: stop() ends the run as stopped, with its reason, even from a promise chain
tests.reason: Code catches stop() and performs work after requested termination.

tests.name: require resolves the project's own node_modules
tests.reason: Project-local dependencies resolve in daemon rather than requested project.

tests.name: a non-serializable return is an error
tests.reason: Non-JSON result silently succeeds.

tests.name: a return over maxOutputBytes is an error
tests.reason: Oversized code return exceeds durable result cap.

tests.name: a default export that is not a function is a clear error
tests.reason: Invalid module export succeeds or cannot report failure.

tests.name: a syntax error is a failure
tests.reason: Require a SyntaxError stack as well as a failed result. Previously any unrelated host failure could pass. JavaScript module syntax plus workflow design §5.6 establishes the independent bad-module diagnostic; real child-process/durable-result seam survives internal code-host refactors. A user throw exercises invocation, not import parsing.

tests.name: sh works too, and the cwd is the request's
tests.reason: Requested sh/cwd contract is ignored.

tests.name: each stream is capped with one notice line
tests.reason: Stream bytes exceed 50 MiB cap or truncation duplicates notices.

tests.name: the environment is built, never inherited
tests.reason: Daemon credentials leak or workflow identity env can be spoofed.

tests.name: an invalid env name refuses the spawn
tests.reason: Invalid env identifiers reach process spawn.

tests.name: a missing cwd refuses the spawn
tests.reason: Missing cwd silently runs in daemon/project fallback directory.

tests.name: the runner enforces the deadline itself
tests.reason: Detached runner depends on live daemon to enforce its deadline.

tests.name: a work that ignores SIGTERM is SIGKILLed after the grace
tests.reason: Replace the shell loop that forks sleep every50ms with exec tail -f /dev/null after installing the same ignored SIGTERM disposition and ready marker. POSIX exec preserves ignored signal disposition. Real OS SIGKILL/cancelled assertions and the specified real5s grace remain. No fake sandbox test can prove escalation of an actual signal-resistant process. This removes repeated process creation without weakening isolation or changing production.

tests.name: a cancel kills the whole group, grandchildren included
tests.reason: Process-group cancellation leaves grandchildren alive.

tests.name: kill() ends a running attempt
tests.reason: Explicit kill returns while work remains active.

tests.name: a runner killed outright reads as interrupted, and its work is ended
tests.reason: Killed runner leaves orphan work or invents a successful exit.

tests.name: a restarted daemon adopts a running attempt and reads its exit
tests.reason: Restarted runner cannot adopt durable process handle and exit record.

tests.name: isAlive refuses a recycled pid (starttime mismatch)
tests.reason: Recycled pid is treated as the original work and risks signaling unrelated process.

tests.name: values are stored 0600 (also after an existing file was looser) and never listed
tests.reason: Secret values reach listing/logs or loose permissions survive rewrite.

tests.name: a workflow's own secret shadows a global one; list shows both scopes; deleteForWorkflow removes its own
tests.reason: Scoped value leaks across workflows or deletion removes global fallback.

tests.name: names and values are validated: 400 SECRET_INVALID
tests.reason: Invalid/oversized credential records are persisted.

tests.name: a foreign-version file is moved aside, without quoting a value
tests.reason: Future-version credential file is overwritten or quoted in diagnostics.

tests.name: an unreadable path makes the store read-only (503) and preserves existing content
tests.reason: Unreadable secret file is replaced by a writable empty store.

tests.name: create → read back; persisted atomically at 0600; a reload lists it
tests.reason: Create/reload loses definition, private mode, or safe disabled default.

tests.name: tolerant load: rejected entries and unknown keys are written back verbatim and never listed
tests.reason: Save erases unknown fields/rejected/newer records.

tests.name: a corrupt or foreign-version file is moved aside, never overwritten
tests.reason: Corrupt/newer-version definitions file is overwritten.

tests.name: an unreadable path blocks mutation with 503 WORKFLOWS_UNAVAILABLE and preserves content
tests.reason: Unreadable definitions path allows destructive mutation.

tests.name: revisions: +1 on every write, a stale revision is a 409 naming the current one
tests.reason: Stale edits overwrite newer changes.

tests.name: a bad patch op is 400 INVALID_WORKFLOW naming the op, and changes nothing
tests.reason: Later failing patch commits earlier operations.

tests.name: a definition with errors saves disabled, but can never be (or stay) enabled
tests.reason: Invalid workflow is enabled or remains enabled after bad edit.

tests.name: a schema-invalid replace is refused whole
tests.reason: Schema-invalid replacement partially mutates definition.

tests.name: limits: the workflow count and the definition size are LIMIT_EXCEEDED
tests.reason: Workflow/definition bounds are bypassed.

tests.name: duplicate: new ids for the workflow, blocks and connections; disabled; pins follow
tests.reason: Duplicate retains live IDs/enabled state or loses pin-edge bindings.

tests.name: events: upserted after every write, deleted after a delete; the bridge publishes summaries
tests.reason: Definition events lose current summaries, revisions, or deletion identity.

tests.name: resolveExisting accepts exactly <workspacesDir>/<ws>/<project>
tests.reason: Workflow project escapes workspace/project containment or selects a subdirectory.

tests.name: createTemp and deleteProject go through the daemon's routes
tests.reason: Temporary clone bypasses daemon routes, unattended policy, or missing-project delete idempotency.

tests.name: a refused create names the daemon's code
tests.reason: Project failure drops daemon error code or silently proceeds detached.

tests.name: gitStatusShort renders porcelain-style lines within the byte cap
tests.reason: Handoff working-tree text loses staged/unstaged/rename meaning or byte bound.

tests.name: pushes per settings.notify, debounced per workflow and kind
tests.reason: Notification settings/debounce spam failures or notify children/test/cancelled runs.

tests.name: FIFO past the cap; aborted waiters leave the queue; force skips it
tests.reason: Concurrency slots lose FIFO order, hold aborted waiter, or release twice.

tests.name: deletes temp projects past deleteAfter and closes old workflow tabs nobody wrote in
tests.reason: Cleanup deletes user-used/live/new tabs or leaks due temporary projects.

tests.name: runs hourly on the injected clock and stops cleanly
tests.reason: Hourly cleanup stops scheduling or continues after stop.

tests.name: a missing file loads empty, silently; updates persist atomically at 0600
tests.reason: Missing state cannot boot or updates fail private durable reload.

tests.name: a corrupt file starts empty, is moved aside and logged — never thrown
tests.reason: Corrupt cursor file prevents boot or is destroyed without backup.

tests.name: bad entries are dropped by the tolerant parse, good ones kept
tests.reason: Malformed cache entry prevents valid cursor recovery.

tests.name: an unreadable path starts empty and logs
tests.reason: Unreadable cursor state prevents boot.

tests.name: concurrent updates are immediately visible and all become durable
tests.reason: Concurrent updates lose another workflow's cursor/cooldown.

tests.name: a throwing mutator changes nothing; a failed write retains changes for the next write
tests.reason: Throwing mutator partially applies or failed-write state is lost on recovery.

tests.name: a newer build's nested fields survive this build's parse (a save never erases them)
tests.reason: Read/save under older build erases newer nested definition fields.

tests.name: block and connection ids that could key Object.prototype are refused, by the schema and by validation
tests.reason: Prototype-shaped node/edge IDs enter persisted graph maps.

tests.name: the secrets file keeps what this build cannot read, verbatim, across a write
tests.reason: Credential save destroys future metadata or rejected records.

tests.name: the secrets store never indexes past its own maps
tests.reason: Prototype map lookup mutates inherited object members.

tests.name: an unfinished run remains recoverable when the index lands before its pending save
tests.reason: Index-first write race makes unfinished run unrecoverable after restart.

tests.name: the summary carries settings.notify so open clients honour it
tests.reason: The isolated projection duplicates the route owner after both default and custom notify values are asserted in the existing list/filter request. The default-values factory and run-store stub add no unique failure.
tests.survivingOwner: routes.test.ts — the list filters by project: the existing project, plus temp workflows of its workspace

tests.name: glob: anchored, `*` stops at `/`, `**` crosses it, `?` is one character
tests.reason: Ref glob accidentally matches nested/unanchored branches or pathological pattern hangs.

tests.name: sameSha compares an abbreviation (Bitbucket Cloud's 12 hex) as a prefix
tests.reason: Abbreviated Bitbucket ID is treated as changed commit or arbitrary tiny prefix equated.

tests.name: pushFired keeps the newest 1000
tests.reason: Dedup history drops newest event or grows beyond documented ring.

tests.name: pull requests: an old PR scrolling into the page is recorded silently; one opened and merged between polls yields both
tests.reason: Older PR scrolling into page triggers work or merged-between-polls PR loses opened transition.

tests.name: pull requests: a lower-numbered new PR walked after a higher one still opens (the mark is the page's base)
tests.reason: Listing order drops lower-numbered new PR after observing higher number.

tests.name: pull requests: dedup keys name the transition — a force-push rollback and a second close after a reopen fire
tests.reason: Force-push rollback/reopen-close transition is incorrectly deduplicated, including legacy state.

tests.name: push: a force-push rollback (A..B then B..A) is a new dedup key, not a repeat of the first push to A
tests.reason: Rollback to previous commit is lost against a pre-upgrade dedup key.

tests.name: push: the first poll only baselines; a later push fires once with previousSha..sha
tests.reason: First poll triggers old work or unchanged head repeatedly fires.

tests.name: push: branch globs; a new matching branch fires with no previousSha; deleted branches are ignored
tests.reason: Branch matching misses new branch or fires on unrelated/deleted refs.

tests.name: push: branches [] watches the default branch, read only when unknown and every 10th poll
tests.reason: Default branch change keeps polling old branch or causes baseline burst.

tests.name: tag: one run per new matching tag (version order), at most 10 per poll, the rest skipped; moved tags ignored
tests.reason: Tag polling repeats/misorders/overfires past per-poll cap or re-fires moved tag.

tests.name: release: drafts never, pre-releases only when asked for
tests.reason: Draft/prerelease policy or promotion dedup is ignored.

tests.name: release on a provider without releases shows an error and fires nothing
tests.reason: Unsupported release provider silently appears healthy.

tests.name: pull_request: opened, updated, merged and closed; the base filter; payload and text
tests.reason: PR state transitions/base filters or event payload fields are wrong.

tests.name: pull_request: Bitbucket Cloud's 12-char head sha compares consistently, first polls within 60 s and then every 180 s
tests.reason: Bitbucket polling quota interval or abbreviated-sha stability regresses.

tests.name: ETags: a baselined listing sends its ETag; a 304 fires nothing and still counts as a poll
tests.reason: Conditional listing omits ETag or changed page never fires new PR.

tests.name: dedup survives a restart: a new poller over the same state never re-fires, and still fires what is new
tests.reason: Restart/dedup ring replays already-fired push.

tests.name: a changed filter or repo re-baselines; a disabled or deleted trigger is pruned
tests.reason: Edited repo/filter runs stale cursor or disabled trigger continues polling.

tests.name: two triggers on one repo share one poller (one ls-remote per poll); another account is another poller
tests.reason: Equivalent URL identities duplicate remote traffic or different account shares credentials.

tests.name: failures back off exponentially to 15 min, show on the trigger, honour Retry-After and never fire
tests.reason: Provider failure causes retry storm, ignores Retry-After, or loses missed work on recovery.

tests.name: a PR listing without the scope says which scope is missing; push triggers on the same repo keep polling
tests.reason: PR scope error hides remedy or stops independent push watcher.

tests.name: an unresolvable repository shows why and polls nothing; stop() leaves no timer
tests.reason: Invalid/unresolved repo reaches remote process.

tests.name: stop() mid-poll commits and fires nothing
tests.reason: Late stopped poll commits state or fires work.

tests.name: a token typed as the URL's user never reaches the poll, the payload or the error text
tests.reason: Token typed in URL reaches remote/payload/provider diagnostic.

tests.name: ETags: a new ETag is written in the same state update as the cursors that judged its page
tests.reason: Committed ETag skips a page whose event cursors were never saved.

tests.name: the pulls poll names the PRs its triggers last saw open (so a DC listing can look them up)
tests.reason: DC closed-PR followup omits previously open numbers.

tests.name: pull_request: an abbreviated head (Bitbucket Cloud) is completed from the branch heads before it fires
tests.reason: Abbreviated PR event launches clone without resolvable full commit.

tests.name: project repositories reject paths outside the workspace project layout
tests.reason: Repository discovery reads outside the configured workspace/project layout.

tests.name: repo kind url: as given, with its account or none
tests.reason: Explicit remote/account is changed or missing public account invented.

tests.name: repo kind project: an existing project's origin + its workspace's account
tests.reason: Project origin is polled under wrong workspace git identity.

tests.name: repo kind project on a temp workflow: its clone URL + that workspace's account; an empty temp project has none
tests.reason: Temporary empty project creates bogus repo or clone loses workspace account.

tests.name: a project whose origin appears later is picked up by the periodic re-resolve
tests.reason: Adding origin after startup never starts monitoring.

tests.name: a new trigger is scheduled from now and fires at its time, once, with the schedule payload
tests.reason: New schedule fires early/twice or publishes wrong scheduled event time.

tests.name: the cursor is persisted before the fire
tests.reason: Trigger fires before cursor reaches disk and can repeat after restart.

tests.name: the timer never sleeps more than 60 s, and a clock jump is noticed within a minute
tests.reason: Host wake/clock jump leaves missed schedule dormant until old timeout.

tests.name: boot: a run missed by less than the grace fires once; beyond it one missed stub, never a burst
tests.reason: Long outage creates catch-up storm or short outage loses permitted fire.

tests.name: edits rearm: a changed cron or zone recomputes from now; disable prunes, re-enable never fires a stale time; delete prunes
tests.reason: Cron/timezone edit, disable/re-enable, or deletion reuses stale cursor.

tests.name: an unrelated edit keeps the cursor; a disabled node is not scheduled; an invalid cron warns once and never fires
tests.reason: Unrelated edit rearms cursor or invalid/disabled node fires.

tests.name: a failed cursor write skips that one run but never stops the timer
tests.reason: Failed cursor save stops scheduler forever or permits unrecorded fire.

tests.name: a failed write while reconciling still arms the timer
tests.reason: Initial reconciliation disk failure prevents recovered timer from firing.

productionFix.contract: Repeatedly protecting persisted executor prompt stages must preserve reversible markers when one secret value equals another secret name.
productionFix.failure: Existing marker names were re-redacted, nesting markers that final reveal did not fully resolve.
productionFix.change: Preserve existing marker spans and redact ordinary spans only.
